jobs.description: Job Description Why join us? At General Motors, our product teams are redefining mobility. Through a human-centered design process, we create vehicles and experiences that are designed not just to be seen, but to be felt. We’re turning today’s impossible into tomorrow’s standard — from breakthrough hardware and battery systems to intuitive design, intelligent software, and next-generation safety and entertainment features. Every day, our products move millions of people as we aim to make driving safer, smarter, and more connected, shaping the future of transportation on a global scale. The Role As a Staff Product Manager for GM’s next-generation in-vehicle experience (IVX), you will play a dual role: First, you will act as a platform product leader for core elements of the shared in-vehicle experience — helping define the product direction, requirements, and evolution of system-level UI capabilities used across vehicle programs. Second, you will represent the end-to-end in-vehicle experience in partnership with vehicle programs, ensuring the hardware and digital experience come together as one integrated product customers can immediately understand, trust, and value. The role is accountable not only for defining shared platform capabilities, but also for ensuring those capabilities come together within vehicle programs as a cohesive customer product across hardware, software, and cabin experience. This is not a pure portfolio strategy role, and it is not a narrow feature PM role. It is a senior individual contributor role for a product manager who can operate at the platform level while also working across real vehicle programs to ensure the full experience is coherent, intentional, and executable. You will report to the Director of Product Management and work closely with Design, Engineering, Program Management, and vehicle teams across GM. What You’ll Do Platform Product Leadership - Core System UI & Shared Experience Foundations Own and shape product direction for key shared elements of GM’s in-vehicle experience platform. Define and evolve product requirements for core system UI capabilities, interaction patterns, and cross-surface experiences that span multiple displays and input modalities. Partner closely with platform PM, design, and engineering counterparts to ensure shared foundations are scalable, usable, and flexible enough to support multiple vehicle programs and brand expressions. Help drive clarity on what should be standardized at the platform level versus where intentional variation is required by vehicle, segment, or brand. Contribute to the long-term experience architecture for the digital cockpit, including how information, controls, system behaviors, and customer touchpoints work together across the vehicle. Vehicle Program Integration - Cohesive End-to-End Experience Represent the in-vehicle experience in partnership with vehicle programs to ensure the hardware and digital product come together cohesively. Work across vehicle programs and segments to translate shared platform capabilities into complete customer experiences that feel integrated across screens, controls, cabin architecture, and key moments of use. Ensure product decisions account for the full customer experience, not just what appears on screen — including the relationship between display layout, physical controls, cabin context, and driver or passenger expectations. Partner with vehicle teams to identify where program-specific needs should inform platform evolution, and where platform consistency should be preserved. C onnect platform strategy to a compelling vehicle experience. Execution & Cross-Functional Leadership Act as a product DRI across your scope, driving alignment and execution with Design, Engineering, Program Management, and vehicle stakeholders. Represent product decisions in leadership reviews, design reviews, and cross-functional working sessions. Work within GM’s vehicle development cadence, aligning product requirements, experience decisions, design maturity, and software milestones with program timing. Identify and manage risks across platform , software, hardware, and vehicle dependencies. Balance tradeoffs across customer value, brand expression, technical feasibility, regulatory requirements, and delivery timing. Customer Insight & Product Strategy Use customer research, market analysis, competitive benchmarking, and product intuition to shape the in-vehicle experience strategy. Help define what great looks like for future in-vehicle experiences across areas such as personalization, voice interaction, driver- assistance UX, system intelligence, and display experiences. Represent the voice of the customer in cross-functional forums while grounding decisions in real constraints and platform realities. When data is incomplete, define learning plans through research, experiments, and instrumentation to improve decision quality over time. Your Skills & Abilities (Required Qualifications) Core Product Management 7–10+ years of product management experience leading large-scale, complex software or connected products such as consumer electronics, mobile OS, smart TV, IoT, automotive HMI, or wearable platforms. Proven ability to own a product domain end to end, from vision and strategy through execution, launch, and iteration. Experience operating across the full PM stack: product vision, roadmap, requirements, prioritization, decision-making, and delivery. Strong judgment in balancing near-term execution with long-term platform and product strategy. Platform & Multi-Surface Experience 4–6+ years working on platform-level or multi-surface products spanning multiple displays, form factors, device types, or interaction surfaces. Strong understanding of how system UI frameworks, interaction models, and design systems enable consistent experiences across diverse hardware. Comfort with hardware-software integration tradeoffs, including display constraints, rendering performance, input modalities such as touch, voice, and physical controls, and responsive or adaptive layout challenges. Experience helping define system behaviors, information architecture, content hierarchy, notifications, or shared UX patterns at scale. End-to-End Experience Integration Demonstrated ability to connect platform capabilities to complete customer experiences rather than optimizing only isolated features. Experience working across software, hardware, design, and delivery teams to bring integrated products to market . Ability to evaluate product decisions in context — considering the relationship between interface behavior, physical environment, customer expectations, and business intent. Track record of bringing clarity to ambiguous product spaces and aligning multiple stakeholders around a cohesive direction. Execution & Delivery 5–7+ years leading cross-functional delivery across engineering, design, program management, and operations in complex environments. Track record shipping multi-surface or multi-product experiences from concept through launch and post-launch iteration. Ability to navigate cross-team dependencies and drive alignment across platform , software, and product stakeholders. Skilled at resolving ambiguity through structured problem framing, crisp requirements, and clear tradeoff discussions. Customer Focus & Communication 4–6+ years leveraging customer research, market analysis, and competitive intelligence to inform product strategy and prioritization. Demonstrated ability to synthesize qualitative and quantitative insights into clear product direction and to establish measurement where it does not yet exist. Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to craft clear, persuasive narratives for executive and cross-functional audiences. A hands-on, high-accountability mindset with a strong instinct to collaborate deeply and raise the bar for product quality and PM craft. What Will Give You a Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications) Experience in automotive, consumer electronics, mobile OS, smart home, TV, or connected device ecosystems. Familiarity with Android-based system platforms such as AOSP or Android Automotive OS, or similar embedded OS environments. Experience with premium or design-led products where quality, craft, and brand expression matter. Background in driver assistance systems, autonomous driving UX, personalization, or intelligent system experiences. MBA or advanced technical degree such as Computer Science, Engineering, or HCI. Demonstrated ability to influence product practices beyond your immediate scope through mentoring, shared standards, or cross-team leadership. Hybrid: This role is categorized as hybrid. This means the successful candidate is expected to report to the office three times per week, at minimum. This position will be located in Warren, MI. Benefits: GM offers a variety of health and wellbeing benefit programs. Benefit options include medical, dental, vision, Health Savings Account, Flexible Spending Accounts, retirement savings plan, sickness and accident benefits, life insurance, paid vacation & holidays, tuition assistance programs, employee assistance program, GM vehicle discounts and more. Company Vehicle: Upon successful completion of a motor vehicle report review, you will be eligible to participate in a company vehicle evaluation program, through which you will be assigned a General Motors vehicle to drive and evaluate. 회사 소개
쿠팡은 고객 감동 실현을 위해 존재합니다. 고객들이 "쿠팡 없이 그동안 어떻게 살았을까?" 라고 말할 때, 비로소 우리의 미션을 실현하고 있음을 알 수 있습니다. 고객들의 쇼핑과 식사, 생활 전반을 편하게 만들겠다는 유일한 집념으로 쿠팡은 수억 달러 규모의 이커머스 산업 전반의 혁신을 이끌고 있습니다. 쿠팡은 가장 빠르게 성장하는 이커머스 기업 중 하나로, 국내 커머스 업계에서의 독보적인 입지와, 고객 신뢰를 구축했습니다.
쿠팡은 스타트업 문화를 기반으로 한 글로벌 대형 상장사라고 자부합니다. 이것이 창립 당시의 기민함을 지하며, 신규 서비스를 끊임없이 출시하며 비즈니스를 확장해 나가는 우리의 성장 동력입니다. 쿠팡의 모든 임직원에게는 기업가 정신을 갖추고 새로운 혁신과 이니셔티브를 추진할 수 있는 기회가 주어집니다. 주저 없이 일에 뛰어들어 성과를 이루고자 하는 과감성이, 바로 쿠팡이 일하는 방식의 본질입니다. 쿠팡에서는 여러분 자신, 동료, 팀 그리고 회사 전체가 매일 성장하는 모습을 목격할 것입니다.
쿠팡의 모든 직원은 커머스의 미래를 만들겠다는 쿠팡의 미션에 진심입니다. 우리는 고객의 문제를 해결해 나가고, 전통적인 관념과 통념에 맞서며 실현 가능한 한계를 뛰어넘고 있습니다. 고가용성 (always-on) 과 최첨단의 앞선 기술 (high-tech), 초연결사회 (hyper-connected world) 에서의 놀라운 업무 경험을 원하신다면, 지금 바로 쿠팡에 합류하세요.
직무 소개
우리는 주어진 역할을 넘어 과감한 실행력을 지향합니다. 쿠팡 리테일은 로켓배송의 압도적인 성장을 실질적인 비즈니스 성과로 창출해 나가고 있는 핵심 조직입니다. 쿠팡 리테일에서는 카테고리 전략과 수익구조를 직접 설계하며 유통 산업의 새로운 표준을 정립합니다. 데이터와 고객 중심 사고로 성장을 견인할 시니어/리드급 인재에게 쿠팡은 커리어 확장의 최고 무대가 될 것입니다. 정해진 답을 따르기 보다 과감한 시도로 성과를 증명해 온 분이라면, 로켓배송과 함께 그 가치를 더 크게 키워 보시기 바랍니다.
로켓배송은?
로켓배송은 세계적 수준의 압도적인 기술과 물류 인프라를 바탕으로 오늘 주문하면 내일 도착하는 쿠팡의 핵심 서비스입니다. 상품의 직접 매입부터 보관, 배송, 반품까지 전 과정을 쿠팡이 책임지는 End-to-End 방식입니다.

Utilize AI coding agents to speed development and iteration. • Identify preferred methodologies to integrate physical verification checks (DRC, connectivity, shorts/opens) into physical design cycles. • Follow and help refine package design rules and guidelines, working with OSAT partners and foundries to ensure DFM compliance. • Collaborate with SI/PI engineers to incorporate electrical constraints into the physical layout methodologies — impedance-controlled routing, power plane optimization, and critical net shielding. About the team Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. Our senior members enjoy one-on-one mentoring and thorough, but kind, code reviews. About the Team
DashMart is a local-fulfillment center owned and operated by DoorDash, offering customers household essentials and other items to their doorsteps with speed, reliability, and quality. Customers order their convenience, grocery, retail, and prepared foods in the DoorDash app, and our team members fulfill orders in a real, brick-and-mortar store for Dashers to deliver. We’re open early and close late - some sites even run 24/7!
About the Role
DashMart is looking for a motivated and experienced individual that excels in fast-paced, physical environments and is excited to roll up their sleeves and actively engage in day-to-day operations. In this role, you will work within a local fulfillment center supporting Site Management running great shifts, and delegating tasks. As a Shift Lead, you will have shift responsibility for fulfilling orders in a warehouse environment and maintaining inventory, and in some locations, this involves preparing food in a light-prep kitchen.
You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…
Be an Owner: Take ownership of your assigned shifts, including warehouse and kitchen processes, safety/cleanliness, quality, and training. Maintain accountability for inventory, equipment, and other company assets to ensure they are properly handled, stored, and protected from loss or theft.
Delight Customers: Ensure customer orders are delivered with high quality by executing orders accurately, communicating with customers when issues arise, and making sure Dasher pickups go smoothly.
Lead: Guide Operations Associates through their shift by ensuring the team works safely and productively and serving as the point of escalation for daily operations.
One Team One Fight: Support operations in both the warehouse and kitchen, assist with day-to-day tasks, and lead by example. You will be expected to engage in professional and respectful interactions with team members and customers, ensuring a positive and safe atmosphere in the warehouse while providing a high-quality experience for our customers.
Help improve operations: Contribute ideas to improve our quality and customer experience.
Food preparation (where applicable):
Perform hands-on kitchen prep, including chopping and slicing ingredients, blending sauces, assembling recipes (e.g., burritos, salads), and completing general kitchen prep tasks to support food staging and delivery.
We’re excited about you because…
You’re self-motivated, positive, and a team player. You work well with others, and you bring a great attitude to your work each and every day. You have high integrity and are excited to delight customers.
You have a proven track record of success in food and beverage, warehouse, and/or retail environments.
You’re able to be on your feet and move heavy products. You are excited and physically able (with or without accommodation) to lift up to 50 lbs., depending on the needs of the specific site, and can operate a pallet jack and hand truck.
You have the ability and desire to obtain and maintain a food handling certificate. (DoorDash will provide this training)
You have a high school diploma or GED equivalent. A college diploma is even better but not required.
You are at least 18 years of age.
You're organized and proficient in Google Docs and Google Sheets.
You have flexibility in your schedule. Depending upon the scheduling needs of the hiring site, you can be available for a number of different shifts a week.

jobs.description: Operations is at the heart of Amazon’s business. We are known for our speed, accuracy, and exceptional service. Our buildings deliver tens of thousands of products to hundreds of countries worldwide, every day. The Reliability & Maintenance Engineering (RME) team are the business partners that work tirelessly behind the scenes to make it happen. We drive continuous improvement, and maintain all the robotics and material handling equipment (MHE) to ensure our customers are met with the Amazon smile. Come join us on our journey! About the Role: As a Senior Automation Engineer, you will play a crucial role in maximizing equipment reliability and operational performance in our fulfillment centers by providing proactive controls automation and technical support. Your expertise will be essential in troubleshooting complex control systems, analyzing performance metrics, and driving continuous improvement initiatives. You'll mentor junior engineers and lead cross-functional teams to optimize material handling equipment (MHE) systems, implement innovative projects, and develop system design improvements to enhance site throughput. You'll work with state-of-the-art technology, including conveyors, sortation systems, scanners, cameras, print and apply systems, and SCADA devices and programs. Through your technical leadership and design optimization efforts, you'll directly contribute to ensuring our customers receive their orders with Amazon's signature speed and accuracy while building team capabilities and driving operational excellence.
